lines.en: Hey, is this true, that you write a lot of your own lines?
Like, remember last week when Alex was in the accident?
Well, the line in the script was,
if we don't get this woman to a hospital, she's going to die.
If this woman doesn't get to a hospital, she's not gonna live.
Oh, okay, I see what you did there.
Aren't you afraid, though, that the writers are gonna be kind of mad when they read this?
Never really thought about the writers.
The scripts just kind of come to my house.
This makes me look good, which makes the show look good,
which makes the writers look good.
So how could they be mad about that?
Makes up most of his lines.
I fall down an elevator shaft?
What the hell does this mean?
I fall down an elevator shaft?
Amber, I want you to know that I'll always be there for you.
As a friend and as your brother.
Some guys are just lucky, I guess.
Dr. Remorae, report to first floor emergency staff.
Anyone else need to go on the elevator?
Did they just kill off Joey?
